examples.english: We have a lot of onions and arugula.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.english: He cut the tomatoes and the onions.
examples.transliteration: Huwa qataa el tamatem wa el basal.

examples.arabic: قمت جبت حتة بصل وحاولت اركبها في المروحة يمكن تشتغل
examples.english: I went and got a piece of onion and tried to install it in the fan, maybe it would work.
examples.transliteration: Omt gibt hettet basal we hawilt arkab-ha fil marwaha yumkin tishtaghal.

examples.arabic: جبت بصل وطماطم وريحتهم كانت حلوة اوي
examples.english: I got onions and tomatoes and their smell was very nice.
examples.transliteration: Gibt basal we tamatem we rehet'hom kanet helwa awi

examples.arabic: قطعت بصل وخضار صغيرة والريحة كانت حلوة اوي
examples.english: I cut small onions and vegetables, and the smell was very good.
examples.transliteration: Qata't basal w khodar soghayyara wel-reeha kanet helwa awi.
